steps.name: Build smill twice and compare
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$COMMIT" || { echo "checkout is not the verified commit $COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin"
go build -trimpath -ldflags "-X github.com/wstein/sheetmill/internal/cli.Version=$VERSION" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/smill" ./cmd/smill
# A second build with an empty build cache must give the same bytes.
GOCACHE="$RUNNER_TEMP/gocache-second" go build -trimpath -ldflags "-X github.com/wstein/sheetmill/internal/cli.Version=$VERSION" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/smill-second" ./cmd/smill
cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/smill" "$RUNNER_TEMP/bin/smill-second"

steps.name: Create the release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# A re-run by someone else must not publish on the owner's earlier approval.
test "$ACTOR" = "$OWNER" || { echo "run triggered by $ACTOR, not by the repository owner $OWNER" >&2; exit 1; }
test "$PUSHER" = "$OWNER" || { echo "run originally started by $PUSHER, not by the repository owner $OWNER" >&2; exit 1; }
# Drafts are invisible to the verify job's read token; refuse any release, draft or not, for the tag.
existing=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/releases" --paginate --jq ".[] | select(.tag_name == \"$TAG\") | .id")
test -z "$existing" || { echo "a release (possibly a draft) for $TAG already exists: $existing" >&2; exit 1; }
# The tag must still name the verified commit; the owner may have moved it during the run.
remote=$(git ls-remote "https://github.com/$REPO" "refs/tags/$TAG^{}" | cut -f1)
test "$remote" = "$COMMIT" || { echo "tag $TAG now names '$remote', not the verified $COMMIT" >&2; exit 1; }
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$COMMIT"
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist"
test "$(ls -1 -- *.tar.gz | wc -l)" -eq 3
cat -- *.tar.gz.sha256 | LC_ALL=C sort -k2 > SHA256SUMS
test "$(wc -l < SHA256SUMS)" -eq 3
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
sh .github/scripts/release-notes.sh "$TAG" "$COMMIT" "$(cat .go-version)" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md"
flags=()
if [ "$DRAFT" = true ]; then flags+=(--draft); fi
gh release create "$TAG" --repo "$REPO" --verify-tag --title "SheetMill $TAG" --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md" ${flags[@]+"${flags[@]}"} \
  "$RUNNER_TEMP"/dist/smill_*.tar.gz "$RUNNER_TEMP/dist/SHA256SUMS"

steps.name: Smoke-test the shipped archive natively
Resolve the version and the run kind
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = push ] && [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then
  sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh version "$REF_NAME"
  version=$REF_NAME
  dry_run=false
else
  version=${INPUT_VERSION:-v0.0.0-dryrun}
  sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh dryversion "$version"
  dry_run=true
fi
{
  echo "version=$version"
  echo "dry_run=$dry_run"
  echo "commit=$GITHUB_SHA"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Require the repository owner to have started the run
Require an annotated tag on a commit of main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Fetch the tag object itself so a lightweight tag is not mistaken for an annotated one.
git fetch --force --no-tags "https://github.com/$REPO" "+refs/tags/$TAG:refs/tags/$TAG"
git fetch --force --no-tags "https://github.com/$REPO" '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
commit=$(sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh tag "$TAG" refs/remotes/origin/main)
test "$commit" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo "tag $TAG names $commit but the run is for $GITHUB_SHA" >&2; exit 1; }

steps.name: Require a green check run for the tagged commit
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# check.yml on a push to main must have succeeded for the commit. The script retries the head_sha
# query, then filters the push runs by head_sha client side.
sh .github/scripts/release-verify.sh ci-green "$GITHUB_SHA"

steps.name: Require that no release exists for the tag
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if out=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$TAG" 2>&1); then
  echo "a release for $TAG already exists" >&2
  exit 1
fi
case "$out" in
  *"HTTP 404"*) echo "no release for $TAG yet" ;;
  *) echo "cannot tell whether a release exists: $out" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

version.description: Dry-run version label (a dispatch never publishes)
